Class Saint

java.lang.Object
seng201.nunbutblood.models.Saint
All Implemented Interfaces:
Purchasable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Executioner, Inquisitor, Oracle
public abstract class Saint extends Object implements Purchasable
Base abstract class for all hero units (Saints/Saints) in the Coven. Handles primary attributes, sanity tracking, financial costs, and temporary power modifications.

  • Constructor Details

    • Saint

      public Saint(String name, String portraitKey, int strength, int wisdom, int dexterity, int sanity, int perception, int hireCost, int upKeep)
      Constructs a new Saint with clamped base attributes and sets initial combat metadata.
      Parameters:
      name - Unique display name
      portraitKey - Reference key matching assets in resources/images/Saints/
      strength - Physical damage and physical check stat (0-20)
      wisdom - Occult affinity and mystical check stat (0-20)
      dexterity - Finesse and agility check stat (0-20)
      sanity - Maximum and starting sanity pool
      perception - Chance coefficient for post-crusade looting
      hireCost - Faith cost up front to hire from the pool
      upKeep - Faith expense required per active crusade mission
